verses.text: A song of ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD and walks in his ways.
You’ll eat what you’ve worked for with your own hands. You’ll be glad, and life will go well for you.
Your wife will be like a vine loaded with fruit within your home. Your children will be like young olive shoots around your table.
That’s how the LORD blesses the one who fears him.
May the LORD bless you from Zion. May you see Jerusalem thrive every day of your life.
May you live to see your grandchildren. Peace be on Israel.
